observations: Photo 0 shows a stack of five tires with visible tread wear, placed on a dirt ground. A silver alloy wheel is partially visible to the left.
Photo 1 shows the same stack of five tires from a slightly different angle, with more detail on the tread pattern. The same silver alloy wheel is visible to the left.
Photo 2 shows four tires lying flat on the ground, with visible tread wear and some yellowish residue on the sidewalls. A silver alloy wheel is visible in the background.
All tires appear to be passenger car tires, not racing or performance types, based on tread pattern and sidewall design.
No brand or model markings are visible on any of the tires in any photo.
The tires are not mounted on wheels; they are shown individually or in stacks.
The seller claims 'Direct Belgium tyres and wheels', but no proof of origin is visible in the photos.

claims.evidence: No visible markings or labels on the tires or wheels in any photo to confirm Belgian origin. The claim cannot be verified from the images alone.

claims.claim: Tread is still 90 percent, no patch, no bulge. Removed from a 2023 car.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Tires may be worn beyond safe tread depth, affecting safety and performance.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of tread depth on each tire, ideally with a tread depth gauge or magnified view.
risks.if_unproven: priced as worn beyond safe limits, which reduces value significantly.

risks.risk: Tires may have hidden damage such as internal bulges, cracks, or dry rot not visible from the outside.
risks.proof: Photo of tire sidewalls showing no cracks, bulges, or discoloration, and a close-up of the inner liner if possible.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Tires may not be from Belgium as claimed, or may be counterfeit or reconditioned.
risks.proof: Photo of the tire sidewall showing country of origin, DOT code, or manufacturer markings.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified origin, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of tread depth on each tire.
Photo of tire sidewalls showing country of origin, DOT code, or manufacturer markings.
Photo of the inner liner or bead area to check for damage or bulges.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
